text:
Alex: Quick thought  DIY pho lunch at the office kitchen next Thurs? we can batch-cook broth and do toppings bar. then rooftop open-mic after (tiny sets). :bowl_with_spoon: :microphone:
Priya: love a build-your-own pho bar. can help with broth prep day before. what time for lunch?
Alex: aiming 12:30 start so people can step away from meetings.
Hector: count me in for broth prep (i have a slow cooker). also can bring rice noodles.
Zoe: will anyone be vegan? i can do a mushroom+tofu vegan broth that reheats well.
Mina: i'm vegan! thanks Zoe. also peanut allergy FYI  pls label toppings.
Priya: noted on peanut allergy. we'll separate toppings bowls and label.
Alex: budget target $12/person if we DIY. rooftop open-mic has no fee but sign-up sheet. quick poll for whether people want to perform?
CalendarBot: Poll created: "Perform at open-mic?" Options: Yes, Maybe, No. Link: https://calendar.example/poll/pm45
Hector: i'll perform a short stand-up set if people want jokes. :grin:
Zoe: i'd rather listen, but happy to help run sound and cord.
Mina: RSVP yes for lunch, spectating for open-mic.
Priya: i'll make a calendar invite and attach ingredient checklist. link: https://calendar.example/event/pho-lunch
Alex: can someone volunteer to eat-test broth on Wed evening? just to confirm seasoning.
Hector: i can do a small taste test 7pm Wed at my place, DM me if you want to come by.
Zoe: i'll bring extra bowls and chopsticks.
Alex: perfect. who wants to be on toppings duty (lime, herbs, sauces)?
Priya: i'll own toppings and labeling. Mina pls remind me about the shellfish cross-contact note.
Mina: will do. thanks for thinking of it.
CalendarBot: Calendar event created and invites sent. Note includes allergy notice and $12 suggested contribution. Link: https://calendar.example/event/pho-lunch-2048
